# GroundwireAI

> GroundwireAI is an Enterprise AI company operating across three pillars: a live, cohort-based Bootcamp for AI and QA engineering training, AI Transformation Consulting, and AI Products. GroundwireAI teaches and builds production-first — what actually ships, not just what demos well.

GroundwireAI was founded by Amit Kayal (Founder — technology leader focused on AI-first, cloud-native enterprise platforms) and Avishek Das (Co-Founder — QA Architect with 13+ years building test architecture and automation at scale, now focused on quality engineering for LLM-powered products).

## Bootcamp

Live, cohort-based training programs. Each cohort is built around one evolving real-world application rather than disconnected exercises.

- [Bootcamp overview](https://groundwireai.vercel.app/bootcamp): all cohorts, curriculum philosophy, and instructor certification
- [Enterprise AI Cohort — Builder Track](https://groundwireai.vercel.app/bootcamp/enterprise-ai-cohort): build one production-ready agentic AI system end to end (RAG, multi-agent orchestration, evaluation, security, deployment)
- [AI Forward Deployed Engineer — Field-Readiness Track](https://groundwireai.vercel.app/bootcamp/ai-forward-deployed-engineer): field-readiness cohort for Forward Deployed Engineers, implementation consultants, and customer-facing solutions engineers
- [Core Playwright & Testing Frameworks](https://groundwireai.vercel.app/bootcamp/core-playwright-testing-frameworks): Playwright test automation fundamentals — Page Object Model, data-driven testing, BDD, parallel execution
- [Advanced Playwright & Production Automation](https://groundwireai.vercel.app/bootcamp/advanced-playwright-production-automation): API testing, CI/CD pipelines, framework architecture at scale, and AI-augmented QA (self-healing locators, agentic workflows via Playwright's MCP server)

## Consulting

- [AI Transformation Consulting](https://groundwireai.vercel.app/consulting): AI readiness assessment, governance, architecture, AI Center of Excellence, production deployment, and managed AI services

## Products

AI SaaS products and agent platforms built with the same production standards GroundwireAI teaches and consults on.

- [Products overview](https://groundwireai.vercel.app/products): all products, in one place
- [Buddhi Health](https://groundwireai.vercel.app/products/buddhi-health): an AI clinical co-pilot that drafts a differential grounded in India-first guidelines — the doctor still decides. Currently an early concept.
- [Solvent](https://groundwireai.vercel.app/products/solvent): AI employees for Indian accounting — reads GSTR-2A/2B, vendor invoices, and books, then prepares reconciliation, exceptions, and filing packets, never filed without sign-off. In development.
- [FlatChat](https://groundwireai.vercel.app/products/flatchat): AI support and sales for Shopify, priced on outcomes (a fixed platform fee plus a component tied to resolved questions and recovered carts) instead of raw AI replies. In development.
